description: This source file defines the class MutableResourceBundleMessageSource, which extends Spring's ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource to implement the MutableMessageSource interface, providing functionality for managing message resources with support for locales, dynamic addition/removal of presentations, and merging message sources within the OpenMRS platform.

classes.name: MutableResourceBundleMessageSource
classes.description: A class that extends ReloadableResourceBundleMessageSource to add mutable capabilities for message sources, such as adding, removing, and merging message presentations, with locale-aware features and integration with the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: getLocales
methods.description: Returns available locales, caching the result for performance.

methods.name: setCacheSeconds
methods.description: Sets cache duration for message properties files.

methods.name: findLocales
methods.description: Discovers locales from existing properties files.

methods.name: parseLocaleFrom
methods.description: Extracts a Locale object from a filename with embedded locale information.

methods.name: getPresentations
methods.description: Retrieves all message presentations across available locales.

methods.name: setBasename
methods.description: Sets a single basename and updates internal basenames array.

methods.name: setBasenames
methods.description: Sets multiple basenames, including module message paths.

methods.name: addPresentation
methods.description: Adds or updates a message presentation in the relevant properties file.

methods.name: removePresentation
methods.description: Removes a message presentation from the properties files.

methods.name: findPropertiesFileFor
methods.description: Finds the properties file containing a specific message code.

methods.name: findPropertiesFiles
methods.description: Searches classpath and modules for message properties files.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another MutableMessageSource into this one, combining message properties based on locale.

methods.name: getPresentation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific presentation message by key and locale (not implemented).

methods.name: getPresentationsInLocale
methods.description: Retrieves all presentations in a specific locale (not implemented).
